seoTitle: GIF Frame Extractor (Split an Animated GIF into PNG Frames)
metaDescription: Decode every frame of an animated GIF, view them as numbered thumbnails with their delays, and download chosen frames as PNG files or all of them in a ZIP.
intro: Split an animated GIF into PNG frames.
why:
Choose a GIF. The page decodes every frame, applies the GIF disposal rules, shows numbered thumbnails with their delays, and offers the chosen frames as PNG files or one ZIP.

Each PNG is the full picture as it appears at that point in the animation, with transparency kept. The decoder was checked frame by frame against Pillow on GIFs with transparency, all three disposal modes and interlacing.
howTo: Enter the frames you want, or leave all.

faq.q: How many frames can it handle?
faq.a: Up to 2000 in the file and 400 per download.
Yes, with the GIF Maker tool.
